about: How a version's action start is found in its median measured run. start: 'first-key' (the first frame after the bot's first key press) or 'screen:<name>' (the first frame of that screen), optionally afterMs later (for a screen that fades in). v1.0 has its own segments (clip time in ms, playback speed). Every later version follows the fixed plan in tools/short.mjs, compared with the version before it.
